prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent reusable fantasy narrative game key-prop, genuinely transparent PNG. Designed narrative reconstruction explicitly approved after a source/story mismatch audit, NOT exact restoration. Image 1 shows the OLD slot and supplies only its historical materials, NOT the new number of objects or mechanisms; image 2 supplies the approved chunky rendering STYLE ONLY, do not copy its subject. Native square 1254x1254 required. Render directly as true RGBA, with genuine transparent exterior and all empty holes/gaps transparent. Keep complete subject within a safe 10% transparent margin on every side. No floor, ground, cast shadow, backdrop, halo, haze, card, frame, checkerboard art, glow or cropped parts. Style: strong dark outlines, broad clean matte color planes, compact chunky fantasy game forms, economical bevels, two or three clear shade levels, no fine texture, tiny scratches or decorative noise. Muted materials, no overbright metal. Important: the whole square canvas will be contain-resized to 124x124 and placed on 128x128 with 2px padding, with no crop or bbox-fit; every core shape/function must remain obvious at that small size. Opaque object cores and naturally antialiased alpha edges. No readable text, letters, numerals, names, heraldry or watermarks.
Subject: EXACTLY THREE independent complete dark iron granary KEYS, clearly separated with wide transparent gaps. NO shared keyring, NO chain, NO joining connector, NO hands. Each key has its OWN chunky circular ring bow, short strong shaft and bold simple stepped key bit. Three parallel slightly diagonal keys arranged side by side in a compact fan with adequate visible air between every part; none overlap or touch. The separate ring bows are muted slate-blue, muted olive and muted ochre-brown, materials/colors borrowed from the three historical rings, but now each bow belongs to its own full key. All three keys have the SAME utilitarian design and comparable size and importance, not a master key and two lesser keys. Their holes are truly transparent and their broad shafts/teeth stay clear at128px. Keep all three complete silhouettes wholly within safe margins. No labels, numerals, badges, shields, locks, inscription, door, pedestal, character or fourth key. The narrative meaning is distributed custody: merchant, militia and refugee each holds a separate key, so do not bind them into one collection controlled by one holder. The old single-key-with-three-rings design is intentionally replaced.
